candidate.summary: After a client write starts replication, selectively drop one append response while an append request to another follower remains pending, then observe alternate-quorum progress.
candidate.suspected_mechanism: workload-invoked-at-coordinator [workload-invoked]: Start one write at the elected coordinator. -> append-response-dropped-while-replication-inflight [message-dropped]: Lose the selected append response while replication remains active. -> alternate-quorum-decision-advanced [decision-advanced]: Use the other follower path to complete normal decision progress.

mechanism_steps.rationale: Start one write at the elected coordinator.
Lose the selected append response while replication remains active.
Use the other follower path to complete normal decision progress.

property.summary: A client operation must remain consistently related to its replicated and applied command across protocol transitions.
